query_plans.notes: Entity search used a sequential scan on 10k rows. Support-time filtering used a sequential scan. Exact ERK used the evidence_record_key bloom skip index. Timestamp context used MergeTree partition/PK filters.

fresh_install.notes: GitHub SSH was unavailable inside LXC, so the candidate tree was copied from a readonly bind mount excluding production uploads/staging/venv/ssl. Reboot after apt upgrade was skipped because the LXC image was already a fresh Ubuntu 24.04 release.
